_what_this_is: the ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE enhancement family as RECORDS — 15 active members plus one BAdI, each with the gate it keys on, where it fires, and what it modifies
_why_structured: this analysis existed and was excellent, in 767 lines of markdown with a 15-row table. Nothing could query it: not 'which members are posting-currency-anchored', not 'which hooks persist versus which only affect an in-memory check', not 'which are dead'. A table a human reads is not a table an algorithm reads.
_the_finding_in_one_line: the members disagree about what THE CONSUMPTION CURRENCY IS. Camp A keys on the reservation's own currency and fires regardless of how it is consumed; Camp B keys on the currency of the row being persisted and skips when they differ. A USD posting against an EUR reservation satisfies A and fails B, so half the family converts and half does not.

_evidence_gap_stated_honestly.resolved: s097 — the class was extracted from P01 (136 objects of package YA) and read. The previously-cited path extracted_code/CLAS/... never existed; the real source now lives at extracted_sap_p01/YA/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL.abap, 634 lines.

camps.A_fr_currency_anchored: key on the RESERVATION's own currency and fire whenever it is EUR, regardless of how it is consumed
camps.B_posting_currency_anchored: key on the currency of the ROW BEING PERSISTED and fire only when that row is EUR
camps.C_filter_exclusion: no gate at all — they DELETE non-applicable rows so standard SAP never sees them
camps.D_auxiliary: orchestration and payroll bridges, plus the dead ones

_what_a_reader_should_take_from_this: FIFTEEN members and only SIX persist. Half the family exists to make in-memory checks pass, which is why an availability check can succeed while the stored figures drift.
The camps are the defect. A USD posting against an EUR reservation satisfies every Camp A gate and fails every Camp B gate, so the reservation side converts and the consumption side does not.
The escape hatch is scoped to symptoms, not to the mechanism: the AVC-skip BAdI covers MIRO and F110 and leaves FB60 exposed.
The carryforward branch (1b) decides how last year's balances arrive this year, so the drift is inherited across years rather than reset.

applicability_perimeter._what_it_is: EIGHT dimensions must ALL pass before any conversion happens, plus an activation date. Each is a CHECK that exits silently, so a single failing dimension means the conversion is skipped with no trace.

dimensions.note: company code — the other 8 entities are outside the perimeter entirely
THE DEFECT. A USD row exits here and the conversion never runs.
PBC pre-commitment, PBC commitment and payroll posting are OUT of the main path

dimensions.rule: IN (SELECT FUND_TYPE FROM FMFUNDTYPE WHERE ZZFIX_RATE = X)
dimensions.note: DATA-DRIVEN on the EXECUTION side: SELECT FUND_TYPE FROM FMFUNDTYPE WHERE ZZFIX_RATE = X. Measured in P01: 14 types, all UNES — 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 009, 010, 012, 013, 016, 017, 018, 094, 095. The old HARD-CODED list is still visible, COMMENTED OUT, at lines 92 and 97 ('019') — the predecessor of the select.
dimensions._but_the_reporting_side_disagrees: YFM_CONSTANT_DOLLAR and its two variants (_V2, _DB_V2) DEFAULT S_TYPE to a LITERAL range 001 to 099, commented 'Set fund type for GEF'. The 14 flagged types all sit inside 001-099, but the range is far WIDER — so the CONSTANT-DOLLAR REPORT covers funds the BUDGET-RATE EXECUTION never converted. Two perimeters in one solution: one data-driven, one literal.
dimensions._the_nuance_that_matters: S_TYPE is a SELECT-OPTIONS defaulted at INITIALIZATION, not a hard gate — an operator can widen or narrow it on the selection screen. So the reporting perimeter is whatever is left on the screen, and the mismatch with execution is silent in both directions.

activation.the_trap: if that variable is missing the code defaults MV_START_DATE to '99991231', so BR silently never activates. A kill switch that fails CLOSED and says nothing.
activation._confirmed_by_user: the switch is exactly what it looks like: an activation DATE, so the solution goes live from a specific day rather than on transport.
activation._correction: the variable was expected to exist only in PRODUCTION. It is in D01 too, with the identical date. Two consequences, and the second is useful: BR is ALSO active in D01 since 2024-01-01, so the behaviour IS reproducible in development — a fix can be tested without touching production. And the 99991231 fail-closed default therefore does NOT apply to D01 today, though it still applies to any system where the variable is absent.

three_gates_not_one._the_finding: the class carries THREE condition methods with THREE different range sets, and the difference between them is where the asymmetry lives.

CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._note: the cure for the currency defect EXISTS in this variant and is unreachable from the main path — the staff gate accepts USD, the main one does not
CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._second_latent_defect: this gate also checks IV_HKONT IN MR_HKONT, and MR_HKONT is DECLARED at line 57 and NEVER POPULATED anywhere in the class. In ABAP a value IN an empty range is FALSE, so whenever a GL account is passed the staff gate FAILS ALWAYS. Same shape as the known defect: a range that gates and is never filled.
CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._second_latent_defect_QUALIFIED: QUALIFIED after reading the production source properly. IV_HKONT is declared OPTIONAL and the check is guarded by IF IV_HKONT IS NOT INITIAL — so the empty-range trap fires ONLY if a caller passes a GL account. And CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 has NO CALLER anywhere in the extracted corpus: only its implementation (line 336) and its declaration (line 573). WHICH RAISES A BIGGER QUESTION THAN THE TRAP: is the STAFF gate used at all? The callers would be in the ENHO members, and THE ENHANCEMENTS ARE NOT IN THE CORPUS — the extractor handles CLAS, PROG and FUGR only, so all 12 ZFIX enhancement implementations are unread. Zero ZFIX files in extracted_sap_p01/YA. Until they are read, 'the staff path is dead' and 'the staff path is never called' are indistinguishable, and both would explain why USD postings never convert.

CHECK_CONDITIONS_3.logic: INVERTED: NOT IN for ledger, company, FM area and business area; and IN for the *3 variants, which INCLUDE GAINS/REVENUE and INCLUDE HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 and EXCLUDE the ZZFIX_RATE fund types
CHECK_CONDITIONS_3._why_it_matters: it decides which rows RFFMREPO deletes during carryforward and recovery

reporting.nature: literal in code, but a SELECT-OPTIONS the operator can change

two_perimeters._consequence: a fund whose type sits in 001-099 but is NOT flagged ZZFIX_RATE appears in the constant-dollar report having never been converted at execution. The report and the engine do not agree on who is in scope, and nothing reconciles them.
